limitations: Synthetic dataset and seeds are not verified to be the official workload.
Local cache policy: fresh empty volume per phase; executable image layers warmed once; no global cache eviction.
Docker Desktop data-device counters include filesystem metadata; this is not the official hardware or cold-cache procedure.
The official frozen resource limits, baseline, score and ranking are not established by this tool.
Only the current synthetic workload and local fixed baseline establish these gains; the formal hidden MySQL admission is not executed.
Exact selection may fall back to full scalar candidate evaluation for cancellation, near ties, extreme magnitudes or cache exhaustion.
Disk-backed large rewrites and index maintenance retain extra durability barriers; one fsync applies to ordinary packed no-index commits.
This changes the canonical storage layout; the new engine reads legacy data, but CURRENT/journal data is not writable by the old engine.
The 128 MiB probe is not the official 2 GiB full-scale workload. Initial journal long tails and the subsequent bounded rewrite correction are retained in the evidence.
All primary rounds improve E against the pre-task baseline; one indexed primary round trails the query-only intermediate. All three additional pairs and the original negative result are retained.
Paired local observations are not a guarantee for all workloads or a confidence interval.
